test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The traveller asked the owner if he could stay in that tavern. The peasant replied that he could.

options.text: The traveller said, "Can I stay in this tavern?" The peasant replied, "She could."
The traveller said, "May I stay in this tavern?" The peasant replies, "You can."
The traveller said, "Can I stay in this tavern?" The peasant replied, "You can."
The traveller said, "Could I stay in this tavern?" The peasant replied, "He should."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The traveller asked the owner if he could stay in that tavern. The peasant replied that he could.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"if he could stay" becomes "Can I stay"**
 
 
• Indirect question "if he could" is converted to direct question "Can I."
 
• Pronoun "he" is changed to "I" to match direct speech.
 
• Verb "could" is changed to "can" to match the present tense in direct questions.
 
 
 
• **"in that tavern" becomes "in this tavern"**
 
 
• Demonstrative pronoun "that" is converted to "this" to match the direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "asked"
 
• Converted to: "said," maintaining the questioning tone.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Can" and ends with a question mark "?".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Can I stay in this tavern?" The peasant replied, "You can."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Can I stay in this tavern?" The peasant replied, "She could." 
 
 
• Pronoun "she" is incorrect as it should be "you" to match the context.
 
• Verb "could" should be "can" to maintain the present tense.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "May I stay in this tavern?" The peasant replies, "You can." 
 
 
• Modal verb "may" is less likely than "can" in this context.
 
• Verb tense "replies" should be "replied" to maintain past tense.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Could I stay in this tavern?" The peasant replied, "He should." 
 
 
• Modal verb "could" should be "can" to match the question format.
 
• Pronoun "he" should be "you" to match the direct speech pronoun change.
 
• Verb "should" is incorrect, it should be "can" to match the context.
